decisions.reason: It is strongly related to the firm's aviation-security knowledge base and already shows credible adoption, so management would expect to keep learning from and scaling it.
Although adjacent to the firm's travel-compliance capabilities, it has weaker visible traction and a less secure long-term fit than the firm's core security and verification offerings.
